build_gdn_attn_backend: build a GDNAttnBackend instance initialized with a ModelRunner for GDN linear attention
run_gdn_forward_decode: run GDNAttnBackend.forward_decode with mixed_qkv, a, b tensors for autoregressive decoding
run_gdn_forward_extend: run GDNAttnBackend.forward_extend with mixed_qkv, a, b tensors for prefill and extend phases
create_gdn_kernel_dispatcher: create a GDNKernelDispatcher that dispatches GDN kernel calls to triton, cutedsl, or flashinfer backends
test_gdn_kernel_decode: test the GDNKernelDispatcher.decode method with q, k, v, a, b tensors and cache indices
